oneViewRule: first view in each frozen sample
groupingRule: same target and capture window; prefix subsets are paired
preprocessingPolicy: RGB decode; ImageOps.fit center crop and bilinear resize to 224x224
uncertainty: paired bootstrap over target-level deltas plus McNemar discordant-pair counts
note: The checked-in car views are a functional synthetic fixture for model/lifecycle qualification, not a calibrated flight dataset.
